propositions: The reconcile-bridge fails on every scheduled pass because runtime.py imports pydantic.SecretStr at module scope, but the bridge installs core without the [agents] extra where pydantic is declared optional.
The stdlib-only contract for the reconciler engine is violated by the eager module-scope pydantic import introduced in commit 40b8ac8295, which activated runtime.py on every bridge pass.
A stdlib-only credential carrier must replace pydantic.SecretStr while preserving credential masking in repr/equality/hash and exact reveal at authentication boundaries.

The clean-runtime subprocess oracle in test_core_optionality.py must be strengthened to load the real reconciler runtime with pydantic explicitly unavailable, catching future module-scope optional-import regressions.
No other module-scope optional imports exist in the reconciler engine after a full sweep of src/rebar/_engine.
